fi.sub.zh: 把切片流水线交付的影片导入为剧集：每部影片一行，交付完成后即可导入。
fi.sub.en: Bring a finished film from the cutting pipeline in as a title: one row per film, importable once it is delivered.

fi.readOnly.zh: 只有审批角色可以导入影片；其他角色可以查看状态。
fi.readOnly.en: Only the approver role can import a film; everyone else can see the state.

fi.company.hint.zh: 先选择影片要导入到哪家公司。
fi.company.hint.en: Choose the company the film is imported for first.

fi.transcript.zh: 同时导入流水线转写的字幕作为分集台词
fi.transcript.en: Attach the pipeline transcript as each episode's script

fi.empty.en: No films in the workspace yet.

fi.notConfigured.zh: 影片工作区尚未接入，请联系 Pulsar。
fi.notConfigured.en: The film workspace is not connected — contact Pulsar.

fi.reason.no_cut_dir.zh: 没有 cut/ 目录（叙述式项目或尚未开始切片）
fi.reason.no_cut_dir.en: No cut/ folder (a narrated project, or cutting has not started)

fi.reason.no_narrated_manifest.zh: 叙述式项目还没有 DELIVERED-narrated.json（Studio 在分集全部通过后写入）
fi.reason.no_narrated_manifest.en: A narrated project with no DELIVERED-narrated.json yet (Studio writes it once the run's episodes have shipped)

fi.reason.no_delivered.zh: 还没有交付的分集方案

fi.reason.bad_delivered.en: The delivered plan does not parse: {file} ({detail})

fi.reason.recent_write.zh: {file} 在 {seconds} 秒前刚写入，等渲染安静下来再导入
fi.reason.recent_write.en: {file} was written {seconds} s ago; waiting for the render to settle

fi.reason.count_mismatch.zh: 方案有 {planned} 集，找到 {found} 个文件
fi.reason.count_mismatch.en: The plan has {planned} episodes; {found} files found

fi.reason.placeholder.zh: {file} 只是云端占位文件，内容不在本机
fi.reason.placeholder.en: {file} is a cloud placeholder; its bytes are not on this machine

fi.reason.imported.en: Imported; the plan has not changed

fi.reason.plan_changed.zh: 导入后交付方案有更新
fi.reason.plan_changed.en: The delivered plan changed since the import

fi.reason.files_changed.zh: {n} 个分集文件已重新渲染：第 {episodes} 集
fi.reason.files_changed.en: {n} episode files changed since the import: {episodes}

fi.reason.pending.zh: 上次导入未完成，可以再导入一次
fi.reason.pending.en: The last import did not finish; import it again

fi.progress.transcripts.zh: 正在导入字幕（第 {n}/{total} 集）

fi.result.done.zh: 导入完成：新增 {added} 集，更新 {updated} 集，未变 {unchanged} 集，标记 {flagged} 集。

fi.result.changed.zh: 导入期间交付方案发生了变化，请再更新一次。
fi.result.changed.en: The delivered plan changed during the import; update it once more.
